requirements_summary: Mid-market SaaS product team evaluating Hosted API for internal IT/helpdesk assistant. Need sub-400ms p95 on short-turn customer responses, streaming support for progressive replies, function/tool-calling to query ticketing system and KB, and audit logs + retention controls for compliance. Expect to start on hosted and move to dedicated capacity if latency/cost profile warrants.
notes: Copy from call notes — Product lead (Tom Alvarez) emphasised: "Must feel instantaneous for agents; no long pauses."
Primary workload: internal IT chat for L1/L2 agents, triage + suggested responses, quick KB lookups (~6k docs).
Latency SLO: target p95 < 350ms for 1-2 sentence replies; comfortable with slightly higher for long-form summaries.
Streamed replies + token-level cost transparency are required — they want to show savings vs human-only triage.
Tool calling: need guaranteed at-least-once calls to ticketing API (create/update/search) and structured returns for UI actions.
Security asks: SAML SSO for admin console, audit log retention 1 year, option to redact PII before storage, KMS integration for keys.
EI/ops: interested in auto-batching heuristics but worried about latency spikes during bursts (support-hours peaks).
Finance asked for Hosted vs Dedicated TCO comparison (3 year). Provided initial skeleton — awaiting detailed pricing deck.
Quote from SE: "If we can hit p95 <350ms with streaming + small cache, Dedicated makes sense for predictable cost."
They requested a 2-week POC: ingest KB + 5000 historical tickets, run simulated agent traffic, measure latency/cost and regression on quality.
